items.headline: Repair grants proposed
items.text: A $12 million draft repair-grant program awaits approval; eligibility is unsettled.

items.headline: Staff recommend smaller repair pilot
items.text: Staff replace the $12 million draft with a proposed $4 million pilot covering two service areas; no adoption yet.

items.headline: Hearing reveals disagreement over pilot boundaries
items.text: Speakers disagreed about the two-area limit; no vote occurred, and their views do not measure citywide opinion.

items.headline: Limited repair pilot adopted
items.text: A 7–4 vote adopts a $4 million two-area pilot, with evaluation required before expansion. Applications are not open.

facts: A draft proposes a $12 million home-repair grant program.
Eligibility rules and funding remain unapproved.
The same $12 million draft is under consideration.
Staff revise the draft to a $4 million pilot in two service areas.
The revision remains a recommendation, not an adopted program.
Speakers at a hearing disagree over limiting the pilot to two service areas.
The record does not measure wider resident opinion.
Council adopts a $4 million two-area pilot by a 7–4 vote.
The adopted version requires an evaluation before expansion.
The agency says application instructions and a launch date will be issued later.
No applications are open and no money has been disbursed.
The bulletin does not estimate the number of households served.
Of the adopted $4 million, $600,000 is reserved for administration; $3.4 million is available for grants.
